title: BillingNoticeSettingsDocument
description: How Catch emails organizers about their bills. email names the sender and a pinned Secret Manager version of a catch.transactional-email-credential/v1 secret (provider, accountId, apiKey), the same credential shape event approval emails use; the key itself is never stored here. Without this document, or with email null, bill emails are recorded as notConfigured and only push is sent. Server-only; set by the owner during production setup.
x-owner: Catch owner (production setup); read by Functions bill notice delivery
